result.instructions: Tools for shipcloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Track our recent shipments and show delayed parcels."; "Find a saved customer address before preparing a shipment."; "Quote a shipment before I decide whether to buy its label.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes shipcloud data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shipcloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shipcloud_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shipcloud_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. shipcloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shipcloud_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The shipcloud user behind this API key: id, email, customer number, plan, and the ENVIRONMENT of the key (production = real labels and charges, sandbox = free test labels). Check this before creating labels. GET /me.

tools.name: shipcloud_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers
tools.description: The carriers this account can use, each with its services, package types, additional services and label formats per service. Use the values when creating shipments. GET /carriers.

tools.name: shipcloud_get_default_address
tools.title: Get a default address
tools.description: One of the account's saved default addresses: shipping (the default sender), returns (the default recipient of return shipments) or invoice (the invoice address). GET /default_shipping_address, /default_returns_address or /invoice_address.

tools.name: shipcloud_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments (newest first as shipcloud returns them) with carrier, service, price, tracking number, tracking URL, label URL, addresses and tracking events. Filters can be combined. Paged: pass the previous reply's next_page. shipcloud sends no totals, so next_page is a guess (a full page suggests more). GET /shipments.

shipcloud_tracking_no.description: The shipcloud shipment id / tracking number.

reference_number.description: The reference_number given when the shipment was created.

shipment_type.description: prepared = saved without a label; label_created = has a label; tracking_only = imported tracker.

tracking_status.description: Only shipments with this tracking status.

tracking_status_not.description: Only shipments WITHOUT this tracking status, e.g. delivered.

created_after.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

created_before.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shipcloud_get_shipment
tools.title: Get shipment
tools.description: One shipment by id: addresses, packages with tracking events, price, label URL, tracking URL. Sandbox shipments have no tracking events and price 0. GET /shipments/{id}.

tools.name: shipcloud_get_shipment_quote
tools.title: Quote a shipment price
tools.description: What shipcloud would charge for a shipment (price in EUR excl. VAT). Read-only: nothing is created and nothing is charged. Only works for carrier contracts owned by shipcloud. Use it before shipcloud_create_shipment_with_label. POST /shipment_quotes.

tools.name: shipcloud_create_prepared_shipment
tools.title: Create a prepared shipment (no label)
tools.description: WRITE: save a shipment in shipcloud WITHOUT buying a label (create_shipping_label=false). Nothing is charged and no carrier is contacted; a prepared shipment can be deleted any time. Returns the shipment id. To buy the label use shipcloud_create_shipment_with_label. POST /shipments.

tools.name: shipcloud_create_shipment_with_label
tools.title: Buy a shipping label (costs money)
tools.description: WRITE, COSTS MONEY: create a shipment AND buy its shipping label at the carrier (create_shipping_label=true). With a LIVE key this charges the shipcloud account (price in EUR excl. VAT; get it first from shipcloud_get_shipment_quote) and creates a real label; with the sandbox key it is free and fake. A label can only be cancelled before the carrier's cut-off (about 17:00-20:00) with shipcloud_delete_shipment. The request is sent ONCE and never retried: if it times out or fails with a server error, the label may still exist, so check shipcloud_list_shipments with the same reference_number before trying again. An existing-label lookup and same-instance guard reduce duplicates but are not atomic or global: simultaneous requests across Worker instances can buy duplicate labels. Serialize purchases for each reference and check shipcloud after an uncertain result. Requires confirm=true after the user agreed to the purchase; give a unique reference_number. Shipments needing customs papers are not supported here. POST /shipments.

tools.name: shipcloud_delete_shipment
tools.title: Delete a shipment / cancel its label
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: delete a shipment. A prepared shipment (no label) can be deleted any time. For a shipment with a label, shipcloud cancels the label only before the carrier's cut-off (about 17:00-20:00); afterwards it fails. Cannot be undone. Requires confirm=true after the user agreed. DELETE /shipments/{id}.

confirm.description: Must be exactly true. Set it ONLY after the user has explicitly agreed to delete this shipment (and cancel its label). Ask first; do not assume.

annotations.title: Delete a shipment / cancel its label

tools.name: shipcloud_list_trackers
tools.title: List trackers
tools.description: List trackers: shipments created OUTSIDE shipcloud that shipcloud tracks by the carrier's tracking number (only for your own carrier contracts), with status and tracking events. GET /trackers.

tools.name: shipcloud_get_tracker
tools.title: Get tracker
tools.description: One tracker by id, with status and tracking events. GET /trackers/{id}.

tools.name: shipcloud_create_tracker
tools.title: Track a shipment by its tracking number
tools.description: WRITE: have shipcloud track a parcel that was NOT created with shipcloud, by the carrier's tracking number (only for your own carrier contracts; carriers dhl, dpd, gls, ups). Creates a tracker; no label, no shipping charge. POST /trackers.

annotations.title: Track a shipment by its tracking number

tools.name: shipcloud_list_pickup_requests
tools.title: List pickup requests
tools.description: List carrier pickup requests with carrier, pickup time window, address and the shipments included. GET /pickup_requests.

tools.name: shipcloud_get_pickup_request
tools.title: Get pickup request
tools.description: One pickup request by id. GET /pickup_requests/{id}.

tools.name: shipcloud_create_pickup_request
tools.title: Request a carrier pickup
tools.description: WRITE: order a carrier (dpd, gls, hermes or ups) to pick up parcels at an address in a time window. A real request goes to the carrier and cannot be cancelled through this server; carriers may bill pickups. Without `shipment_ids` the carrier collects all shipments not yet picked up; return shipments cannot be picked up. Requires confirm=true after the user agreed. POST /pickup_requests.

last_name.description: Last name. Give this or a company.

street.description: Street name (may include the house number).

street_no.description: House number, when the carrier needs it separately.

country.description: Country, uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. DE.

phone.description: Phone (mandatory for UPS express services and for international UPS shipments).

pickup_address.description: Where the carrier collects the parcels.

shipment_ids.description: Only these shipments; omitted = all not yet picked up.

confirm.description: Must be exactly true. Set it ONLY after the user has explicitly agreed to order this carrier pickup. Ask first; do not assume.

tools.name: shipcloud_find_dropoff_locations
tools.title: Find pickup and drop-off points
tools.description: Search a carrier's parcel shops, lockers and drop-off points near an address or coordinates (opening hours, distance). Give an address (street, zip_code, city, country) or latitude + longitude. GET /pickup_dropoff_locations.

items.description: Carrier acronym (shipcloud_list_carriers shows the ones this account can use).

tools.name: shipcloud_list_addresses
tools.title: List saved addresses
tools.description: List the address book (saved addresses with ids usable as `to` / `from`). Filter by any field. Paged. GET /addresses.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shipcloud_get_address
tools.title: Get saved address
tools.description: One saved address by id. GET /addresses/{id}.

tools.name: shipcloud_create_address
tools.title: Save an address
tools.description: WRITE: save an address in the shipcloud address book (no shipment, no cost). Returns its id. It cannot be removed through this server. POST /addresses.

last_name.description: Last name. Give this or a company.

street.description: Street name (may include the house number).

street_no.description: House number, when the carrier needs it separately.

country.description: Country, uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. DE.

phone.description: Phone (mandatory for UPS express services and for international UPS shipments).

tools.name: shipcloud_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders sent to shipcloud (order data with line items, used by the Return Portal and linked to shipments by order_id). GET /orders.

tools.name: shipcloud_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id, with delivery address and line items. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: shipcloud_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured in the account: target URL, subscribed event types, deactivated flag. Credentials of a webhook are never shown. GET /webhooks.
